summary: J-Star Holding Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to furnish notice of its upcoming annual general meeting (AGM) scheduled for June 8, 2026. The meeting agenda includes routine proposals to appoint WWC, P.C. as auditors, re-elect five directors (including CEO Jing-Bin Chiang), approve a share consolidation (reducing authorized and issued Class A and Class B shares at a 1:5 ratio), and adopt a Sixth Amended and Restated Memorandum and Articles of Association. No price, premium, or special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or activist campaign is present. This is ordinary corporate housekeeping, not a special situation.
